_comment: Rope-intervention arms for the FOLLOW-UP session. The schema mirrors configs/mlsys_rope_intervention_candidates.json exactly -- 'name' (not 'candidate'), 'expect', 'role' candidate/baseline, and 'native_baseline': true on the control -- because mlsys_coherence_gate.py's load_candidates reads those keys, and a file with the wrong key names yields no candidates at all rather than an error. Three arms, identical except the target's rotary block, all with rope_anchor_base 8192 so a difference is attributable to the FACTOR and not to swapping rope implementations. REHEARSAL TWIN: same arms and fields, context_length 4096, so the gate step genuinely executes on the 1x rehearsal GPU and every code path in the gate is exercised before the 8x follow-up launches.
